title: FBI-UAP-D013, Washington State ‘UFO’ Investigation, 1952-1960
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FBI memoranda and correspondence regarding UAP/UFO sightings in Washington State between 1952 and 1960, containing significant redactions.

incidents.summary: Witness observed a disc-like object that appeared to have all control surfaces removed, hovering near Pasco, Washington.
Witness observed a very large object high in the sky directly above and west of Sand Point Naval Air Station.
Witness observed a bright object in the sky high over Sand Point Naval Air Station.
Witness observed a bright shimmering object at extreme altitude that darted off to the west.
Witness observed a metallic object in the sky flying westerly.
Ground observer group supervisor reported two half-moon shaped objects over Pasco, Washington.
Witness observed two bright objects in the sky resembling falling stars.
Police officer observed a large, shiny, spherical metal ball hovering over Kennewick, Washington.
Witness observed small objects flying away from the Alaska Union Oil Company.
Witness observed a man on a beach with a device and bright flashes.
